C1.source: Read original abstract p.1 and the four model/dataset cells in Table2 p.6, with setup p.5.
C1.independent_argument: Independently transcribed SIMPLEMIX, off/on DPO, HyPO and DPO-Mix-P LC values and recomputed equally weighted baseline differences using decimal arithmetic.
C1.alternative_and_dependency: Tulu-only means are 6.025 and 3.05 percentage points, reproducing the headline after rounding. The full grid differs, so neither fabrication nor a false ranking follows. The abstract does not expressly require a full-grid denominator.
C1.severity_and_repair: Needs Evidence/scope clarification retained; the intended subset remains unknown. Naming Tulu and percentage points or replacing by the pooled values each produces an explicit consistent summary.

scope.source: Read Eq.(1) p.2 and equal-probability pair-source description/one-epoch control p.5; compared report conclusion and coverage limitations.
scope.independent_argument: For a fixed pair loss ell, integration against (Pon+Poff)/2 equals the arithmetic mean of the two source expectations. This proves only a loss identity and does not imply averaging fitted models or scores. All four Table2 LC rankings survive the independent arithmetic above.
scope.alternative_and_dependency: The source acknowledges unequal sampling compute and initial-SFT on-policy convention. Absence of run-level pairs, seeds and author-specific executable prevents a new statistical-significance or implementation verdict. Initial eight-task means and visual checks are not represented as a new full-paper rereview.
scope.severity_and_repair: No substantive objective defect established in this focused scope; retain honest limitations and no issue quota.
